summary: UTime Ltd filed a prospectus supplement on Form 424B5 for a registered direct offering of 200,000 Class A ordinary shares and pre-funded warrants to purchase up to 800,000 Class A ordinary shares at a combined price of $1.20 per share equivalent, with the warrants having a $0.50 exercise price. The offering is at a discount to the last sale price of $1.50. Univest Securities acts as placement agent on a best-efforts basis with no minimum offering amount. This is an ordinary equity financing, not a special situation.
